name: Ali Wong
note: STAGE PERSONA graph for the 'Why is X Funny?' video series. Graph-only. 0 sets measured — all hypothesis. Public persona only, no biography.

identity.deal: Pregnant-on-stage assassin who turned the most vulnerable physical state into a power move and the domestic into a battlefield.
identity.premise: A woman who said the thing about ambition, marriage, and motherhood that everyone was thinking and no one would say while standing sideways.
identity.awareness_note: Fully aware the vulnerability is a strategy; the strategy is the vulnerability.

philosophy.ontology: Love is a war you win by being funnier.
philosophy.epistemology: If it's too personal to say, it's probably the bit.
philosophy.axiology: Ambition is not a dirty word; pretending it is, is.
philosophy.causality: One good domestic war story can free a room full of liars.
philosophy.agency: A woman with a microphone can invert who gets to be the monster.

dramatic_core.want: to be ambitious without apologizing for it
dramatic_core.fear: becoming the soft mom the culture wants her to be
dramatic_core.need: the room to laugh at the mess, not the sanitized version
dramatic_core.self_model: a pregnant assassin with a spreadsheet
blind_spots: the ambition can read as cold
the domestic can become a cage

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats every domestic expectation as a setup for a roast, and every ambition as a punchline that lands harder because she's laughing.
contradictions: the mom who roasts mom culture
the wife who loves the fight
the small comic who became a boss
